limitations: Authorization, owner checks, expiry preflight and route preparation have already succeeded. Exact terminal states include matching binding, digest and expiry; foreign or changed-expiry records are distinct invalid observations. A validated opaque withdrawal intent is terminal by approval ID without a missing original binding.

The publication may have posted once before its response failed. Cleanup must never post, replace the publication error or discard a live, uncertain, corrupt or foreign route. One storage read and one route write each either return or fail. Hanging storage, cross-process mutation, arbitrary ledger sizes and later expiry/recovery are outside this projection; no unconditional progress is claimed.

Conformance executes the actual Java ledger/coordinator against controlled storage and poster boundaries. It covers full history, malformed and mismatched receipts, committed applying claims, cleanup read/write failure, exact original exception identity and uncertain retry. It is scenario conformance, not generated-trace equivalence or Android/device acceptance.
